arguments.command: cd $CLONE && ls tests | head -50 && ls && cat TESTING.md 2>/dev/null | head -40
cd $CLONE && find tests -type f | head -50; find tests -type f | wc -l; grep -n -i "tests/" CHANGE-VALIDATION.md | head -20

cd $CLONE && grep -n -E "doclint-tests|gate-cellcheck|plan-relations" CHANGE-VALIDATION.md | head -20; grep -rln "tests/fixtures" --include=*.py --include=*.rs --include=*.sh . 2>/dev/null | grep -v target | head

cd $CLONE && uv run _shared/test_doc_lint.py > /tmp/doclint.out 2>&1; echo exit=$?; grep -n -E "FAIL|ERROR|Error|failed|passed|^Ran|OK" /tmp/doclint.out | head -30; bash docs/plans/plan-049-james-dixson-725bc0/scripts/gate-run.sh docs/plans/plan-049-james-dixson-725bc0/scripts/gate-cellcheck.sh > /tmp/gate.out 2>&1; echo gate=$?; tail -5 /tmp/gate.out

cd $CLONE && grep -rn "plan-relations" --include=*.py --include=*.rs --include=*.sh --include=*.md . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./target" | grep -v "tests/fixtures" | head; grep -n -E "good\.md|finding|'plan'" _shared/test_doc_lint.py | head -20; git status --short | head; git log --oneline -3
cd $CLONE && grep -rln "fixtures/plan-relations\|m1-R1-dangling" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./tests/" | head; grep -n "plan-relations\|R1b" _shared/test_doc_lint.py | head
